title: Pattern Bracelet Studio
shareTitle: Pattern Bracelet Studio 📿 — String, Play, Hear Your Pattern
description: String clay beads into AB and ABC patterns on a wooden bracelet, then press PLAY to hear your pattern as music — every color is a chime. Invent your own bracelet song in Free Jam!
learningGoals: Recognize and extend AB repeating patterns by color
Extend ABC and ABB patterns with two missing beads
Hear visual patterns as musical sequences and invent original patterns
Connect color order to sound and rhythm through playful composition
interactionModel: tap or drag clay bead from tray onto glowing empty slot; PLAY runs circular sequencer
feedbackModel: Correct bead pops with its chime and sparkle; wrong bead wiggles with warm spoken pattern nudge; finished bracelet sparkles, closes, and plays full musical loop

modes.title: Pop Pattern
modes.skill: AB pattern extension with musical playback

modes.title: Free Jam Studio
modes.skill: invent and hear your own bead pattern as music

credits: Claymation bead and workshop art generated for this game; voice via Qwen TTS voice clone. Built for QLOBE Kids.
